SELECT
        toYear(created, {timeZone:String}) AS year,
      toMonth(created, {timeZone:String}) AS month,
      toDayOfMonth(created, {timeZone:String}) AS day,
        sum(part) AS count
      FROM (
        SELECT toDateTime64(hour, 3, 'UTC') AS created, countMerge(uniques) AS part
        FROM {database:Identifier}.views_hourly
        WHERE domainId IN {ids:Array(String)}
          AND hour >= {hot:DateTime64(3)}
        GROUP BY hour
        UNION ALL
        SELECT created, count() AS part
        FROM {database:Identifier}.records FINAL
        WHERE domainId IN {ids:Array(String)}
          AND created >= {from:DateTime64(3)}
          AND created < {hot:DateTime64(3)}
          AND clientId != ''
        GROUP BY created
      )
      GROUP BY year, month, day
